children: US community bank's Q3 net income rose 6.6% yr/yr, with diluted EPS up to $2.41
Net interest income for Q3 increased 5.1%, net interest margin improved to 4.64%
Noninterest income fell 22.7% in Q3, mainly due to lower gains on foreclosed assets
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
NET INTEREST MARGIN - Co said Q3 net interest margin improved to 4.64% as yield on earning assets increased and cost of interest-bearing liabilities decreased
DEPOSIT GROWTH - Co attributed increase in cash and cash equivalents to strong deposit growth during the period
NONINTEREST INCOME DECLINE - Co said lower noninterest income in Q3 was mainly due to reduced gains on repossessed foreclosed assets compared to prior year
